name: Schloss Drachenburg
_about: SCHLOSS DRACHENBURG over the Rhine at Königswinter (1882-84): a historicist castle-villa on its terrace -- the main house with its gable bay and rose, the loggia, the south front's porch, oriel and gable between two round towers with tall slate cones; the Hauptturm with its clock, gables, corner turrets and steep slate spire; the Kunsthalle with its rose gable and dome; the crenellated Nordturm; the crenellated terrace on its hillside with the round bastion, its flights and corner turrets. Plan from OpenStreetMap, heights from photographs (tools/archgen/drachenburg.py).

terrace._about: the terrace on the hillside: OSM's castle wall (way 118449146) as a podium, its round bastion on the Rhine front -- the house's level

venusterrasse._about: the Venusterrasse: the terrace's south end, the walled garden a flight below the house's level

hill._about: the hillside the terrace is cut into: its top 3.4 m up on the uphill side, falling to the Rhine front under the terrace

bastion._about: the round bastion on the Rhine front, its top the terrace's

bastion stair north._about: down from the terrace along the bastion's flank to the landing before it

bastion stair south._about: down from the terrace along the bastion's flank to the landing before it

portal stair north._about: a flight from the hillside up to the terrace

portal stair south._about: a flight from the hillside up to the terrace

freitreppe._about: the Freitreppe: up from the Venusterrasse to the terrace before the south front

landing._about: the landing before the bastion where its two flights meet

bastion stair._about: the flight from the path up to the landing

gatehouse._about: the gatehouse on the path up from the Rhine: a pointed arch through it

terrace turret north._about: the round turret on the terrace's north-west corner, from the slope below

terrace turret east._about: the round turret on the terrace's north-east corner

terrace turret south._about: the squat turret at the terrace's south end

house._about: the main house's block: three storeys over the terrace, the portal at the back (east) under its porch

south wing._about: the south wing: its front the south front -- the porch, the oriel over it, the gable -- between the two round towers

corner wing._about: the corner between the south wing and the round tower, behind the loggia

gable bay._about: the gable bay on the Rhine front: tall traceried windows, a three-light one over them, the rose under its gable

gable bay gable._about: its stone gable, pinnacles on the kneelers and the apex

loggia._about: the arcaded loggia on the Rhine front, open in four pointed arches

loggia balustrade._about: the stone tracery balustrade round the balcony over it

south porch._about: the south porch: three pointed arches to the garden front

south oriel._about: the oriel over the porch, on the first floor of the south front, its flat top a balcony for the window over it

house roof._about: the main house's roof: steep slate slopes to a flat top

house cresting._about: iron cresting along the roof's flat top

south wing gable._about: the south front's gable, between the round towers

south-west tower._about: the round tower on the south-west corner, its tall slate cone over the eaves

south-east tower._about: the round tower on the south-east corner, set back from the south front

house dormer 1._about: a dormer on the back slope

house dormer 2._about: a dormer on the back slope

house dormer 3._about: a dormer on the back slope

stair hall._about: the stair hall between the Kunsthalle and the house

portal porch._about: the portico before the main portal on the hill side (reconstructed 2008-11), open in pointed arches, the two flights to either side of it

hauptturm._about: the Hauptturm on the Rhine front: square, a clock on every face, the belfry, four gables, four corner turrets with stone caps, the steep slate spire

kunsthalle._about: the Kunsthalle: two tall storeys of traceried windows

kunsthalle risalit._about: the Kunsthalle's risalit on the Rhine front: traceried windows and the rose under its gable

kunsthalle dormer._about: a wall dormer on the Kunsthalle's front, its gable and pinnacles of red stone

kunsthalle roof._about: the Kunsthalle's roof: slate slopes to a flat top railed with iron, the dome rising from its middle

kunsthalle cresting._about: iron cresting along the roof's flat top

kunsthalle dome._about: the Kunsthalle's dome (rebuilt 2001-03): an octagonal drum of windows on the flat of the roof, a pointed slate dome, a lantern

north wing._about: the wing between the Kunsthalle and the Nordturm

nordturm._about: the Nordturm, the keep at the north end: square, machicolated, crenellated, its stair's turret over the deck

nordturm turret._about: the round turret before the Nordturm, its slate cone

nordturm bartizans._about: the little corner turrets on the Nordturm's deck (the watch turret takes the fourth corner)

hall wall._about: the hall's wall on the hill side: the doors to the Kneipzimmer and the Billardzimmer

billiard wall._about: between the Kneipzimmer and the Billardzimmer, a door through

hall front wall._about: the hall's wall on the Rhine side: the doors to the dining room and the music room

music wall._about: between the dining room and the music room

stair hall floors._about: the stair hall's upper floors round the stair's well

thresholds._about: the floors through the doorways in the doubled walls, upstairs

great stair._about: the great stair: up the stair hall to the landing at its Rhine end, back up beside itself to the next floor -- twice

stair balustrade._about: the gallery's balustrade along the stair's well

kunsthalle screen._about: the screen parting the Kunsthalle's domed end off: one wide pointed arch

vorburg._about: the Vorburg: a two-storey hall, its gate in the middle of the front toward the castle

vorburg gate gable._about: the big Zwerchhaus over the gate

gravel walks._about: the gravel of the garden, square to its walls

lawns._about: four lawns round the fountain, square to the garden

flower beds._about: a round bed of flowers in each lawn, in tiers like a cake

lawn north._about: the lawn by the Nordturm, square to the terrace's wall there

fountain basin._about: the fountain's octagonal basin in the middle of the Venusterrasse

fountain column._about: the column in the basin's middle

fountain figure._about: on the column, the figure facing the house: Venus once (the terrace's name), a robed figure since the 1930s

stag pedestals._about: the stags' pedestals beside the Freitreppe's foot

stags._about: the two gilt stags beside the Freitreppe, looking out over the garden
